note: Websites that publish free question papers, in the order the collector works through them. 'dailyCap' = most papers per site per day (0 = no cap; Admin > Question papers can override), 'pauseSeconds' = polite delay between requests to that site, 'hideKey' = the word Admin uses to hide a site's papers on a rights holder's request. Aggregators (commercial) stay OFF; commercial publishers, login-only and CAPTCHA sites are never added. The collector checks robots.txt itself, never signs in, never solves a CAPTCHA and never follows link shorteners. status 'seed' = not yet checked from the owner PC: run Discover-Question-Paper-Sites.bat.
